thread:
elaine_cs: FYI BrightLight (Dedicated customer) reported a sudden drop in rerank quality after last night's infra changes. They say top-1 precision fell from ~72% -> ~54%.

elaine_cs: Sample query + returned scores they sent:
```text
query: "how to reset MFA on mobile"
results: [doc_23: 0.87, doc_7: 0.83, doc_90: 0.12]
```
They said we were using redwood-embed-v1 (float16) + dot product and rerank model redwood-rerank-rrk-v2. This started around 03:38-03:40 UTC when routing shifted to the dedicated-optimized pool.

elaine_cs: Customer asks for priority; they're worried about user-facing regressions and revenue impact.

tom_product: Copy. Tagging sam_ml and jess_research. @sam_ml can you confirm what changed in that time window? Is there any quantization/embedding recompute that could cause this?

sam_ml: I checked the deploy log — rrk-v2 rollout started 03:38 UTC, routing change to dedicated-optimized pool happened 03:40 UTC. No embedding model change recorded. Need a sample set (200-500 queries) to compute MRR/NDCG. Can run an offline eval if CS provides.

jess_research: If top-1 drops but top-5 is similar it could be a scoring calibration change in rrk-v2. Also worth checking dot vs cosine behavior after the routing change (different numerics on that pool). Requesting top_k distribution and a few example vectors.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout rrk-v2 to prod (started 2026-03-19 03:38:12 UTC).

elaine_cs: Uploading the export now — 312 query ids. link: https://s3.redwood/brightlight/exports/brightlight_312_0319.csv
They ran a local compare against their index and still saw mismatches.

elaine_cs: They asked for either a hotfix/rollback or a clear timeline for resolution.

tom_product: Proposed triage plan:
- reproduce regression on our eval infra
- if reproduced -> short-term rollback to rrk-v1 + routing revert (customer-facing hotfix)
- long-term -> investigate rrk-v2 scoring calibration and add regression tests

Is this a P1? @sam_ml ETA to run eval with 200 queries?

sam_ml: Can kick off eval in ~2 hours. Starting with 200 random queries from their export. If we confirm regression, we can request oncall rollback. Also will check embedding similarity distributions and numeric differences (float16 vs float32 ops on dedicated pool).

jess_research: Please create a backlog ticket so product + eng can track. Suggested ticket: RED-3421 — "BrightLight rerank regression: investigate rrk-v2 scoring + routing change". Suggested launch criteria for fix/rollback:
- Reproduce regression on our eval set with their queries
- Identify root cause (scoring calibration vs numeric drift vs routing)
- Short-term: rollback validated with >95% parity on precision@1 for their key queries
- Long-term: add automated regression test and calibration step before rrk rollouts

elaine_cs: :thumbsup: I'll tell BrightLight we escalated and request 500 additional failing examples and their expected ranking for a handful of queries.

tom_product: @ops oncall can you standby for a rollback if sam_ml confirms regression? Also assigning to @sam_ml in the ticket.

sam_ml: Acknowledged. Kicking off eval job now. Will post MRR/NDCG and raw logs once done.

jess_research: Also recommend we check if batching or KV cache differences in the dedicated pool could change ordering due to floating point nondeterminism. Add that to RED-3421 scope.

elaine_cs: Customer reply: they prefer rollback if it's a simple revert. They want weekly updates otherwise.

tom_product: Cool. I'll follow up with oncall and product leadership after sam posts results. Keep thread updated.

sam_ml: Posting interim results: initial 200-query run shows precision@1 drop 71.6% -> 55.1%, NDCG@5 down ~12 points. Uploading small log snippet:
```
failed_query_id: 98721, top1_v1: doc_23, top1_v2: doc_90, scores_v1: [0.92,0.85,...], scores_v2: [0.12,0.83,...]
```

tom_product: Ok — clear regression. Proceed with rollback approval request. I'll ping oncall.

elaine_cs: Customer updated: they will accept rollback now. Thanks.

jess_research: Added note to RED-3421: scope = immediate rollback option OR if rollback not possible then calibration patch. Triage owner = sam_ml, product owner = tom_product.

elaine_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send a short update to BrightLight and attach the ticket.

sam_ml: Will post full evaluation artifacts (NDCG/MRR CSVs, vector diffs) in the ticket thread when ready.

tom_product: :eyes:
